page.overview:
What is Cybernetic Heart?

A Cybernetic Heart is a cybernetically enhanced attachment to the wearer, granting them new abilities and properties with the device.

Kano is a Human with no supernatural abilities but with his connections to the Underground Black Market, he is able to get his hands on Advanced Cybernetic Technology. He has used his connections for profit but also to constantly upgrade his cybernetics, such as the Cybernetic "Heart" he wears on a Bandolier across his chest. This device serves as a Power Supply for all his Cybernetic Enhancements and when activated it boost his power and strength.

In Mortal Kombat X, Kano's Heart alongside the rest of his cybernetics changes the color of their lights depending on what variation has been chosen. With Cybernetic giving them the signature red glow, Commando making them glow yellow, Cutthroat having then glow blue and when going variation-less has them glow green.

In Mortal Kombat 11, Kano's Cybernetic Heart is a customized Gear Item and he has a wide variety to choose from. The "Heart" is now used as a weapon rather than just enhancing his abilities, granting news ways of drawing the opponent in, stunning them and enhancing Kano like it did in MKX.
